categories.main_business_segments: Sirio Pharma Co., Ltd. is a global leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) specializing in nutritional health foods. Its primary business includes research and development, manufacturing, packaging, logistics, and marketing support for functional foods, special dietary foods, and health supplements. The company focuses on six key product categories: anti-aging, probiotics, beauty health, cardiovascular and metabolic health, immune enhancement, and sports nutrition.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies such as biomimetic enhancement platforms (E Cube biomimetic enhancement technology), plant-based softgel capsules, and innovative dosage forms including soft capsules, nutritional gummies, beverages, tablets, powders, and hard capsules. It has developed proprietary technologies for improving bioavailability and product efficacy, supported by extensive R&D centers in China, Europe, and the US. Digital systems like ERP, PLM, MES, and AI-driven R&D tools enhance product development and manufacturing efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sirio Pharma serves a broad range of B2B customers including pharmaceutical companies, direct sales enterprises, non-direct sales brands, chain pharmacies, modern supermarkets, social e-commerce, food, and cosmetics companies. Its customers are mainly in the nutritional health food sector, spanning both long-established and emerging consumer markets. The company’s products cater to diverse consumer groups across all life stages, including special populations such as infants and pregnant women.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with seven production bases and five R&D centers located in China (Shantou, Ma'anshan, Zhuhai), Europe (Germany), the United States (California), Southeast Asia (Thailand), and sales offices in Singapore and the UK. Its markets cover China, the Americas, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and other regions, with significant revenue growth in overseas markets, especially the Americas and Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sirio Pharma operates primarily as a midstream contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) within the nutritional health food supply chain. It provides end-to-end services from product concept, formulation, manufacturing, to packaging and logistics, serving brand owners and retailers. The company also manages a global supply chain with localized production to mitigate trade barriers and tariffs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on innovation and internationalization. It invests heavily in R&D to develop new dosage forms and functional ingredients, emphasizing anti-aging, probiotics, and plant-based softgel capsules. It pursues global market insights to guide product development, integrates AI and digital tools to accelerate innovation, and participates actively in industry standards development. Expansion of global localized production and supply chain agility are key priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Sirio Pharma generates revenue mainly through contract manufacturing services (CDMO), including original design manufacturing (ODM), customized design manufacturing (CDM), and original equipment manufacturing (OEM). It also has a small portion of revenue from direct brand product sales. The revenue is primarily from product sales to B2B customers worldwide.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading Chinese global CDMO in the nutritional health food industry, recognized for its comprehensive multi-dosage form capabilities and innovation leadership. It competes with other global and regional CDMOs serving pharmaceutical, health supplement, and functional food brands. Its strong R&D, global footprint, and quality certifications provide competitive advantages in a fragmented and increasingly consolidated industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sirio Pharma reported revenues of approximately RMB 4.21 billion, a 17.56% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 325 million, up 15.66%. The company’s overseas revenue grew significantly by 47.33%, while domestic revenue declined slightly. It maintains a solid asset base of RMB 5.49 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D, demonstrating a stable growth trajectory and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sirio Pharma emphasizes its innovation-driven approach, offering scientifically validated, safe, and effective nutritional health products with diverse and advanced dosage forms. Its global localized production and supply chain capabilities enable agile and cost-effective service to international and domestic clients. The company’s proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and participation in industry standards development differentiate it as a trusted partner for high-quality, customized nutritional solutions.
